[[Lieutenant]] '''Jensu''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] individual who flew alongside [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Captain]] [[Carson Teva]], Lieutenant [[Baysee]], Lieutenant [[Mowaat]] and Lieutenant [[Lander (individual)|Lander]] in an [[Incident on Seatos|unauthorized mission]] to [[Seatos]]. After the group detected the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', a massive [[hyperspace transport ring]], exiting the [[atmosphere]] of Seatos, the group flew to cross its axis and block its path. The unit failed and suffered casualties with the ''Eye of Sion'' entering [[hyperspace]] through the group.<ref name="Part Four" />

Soon after, the group landed on Seatos. Despite searching for [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Sabine Wren]], the master and [[Padawan|apprentice]] duo were nowhere to be found. Eventually [[Jacen Syndulla]], Hera's son, was able to sense Tano's presence through [[the Force]] and she was located in the ocean. Jensu jumped into the water from the ramp of the ''[[Ghost]]'' and swam to Tano's rescue, managing to get the barely conscious [[Togruta]] to safety aboard Syndulla's ship.<ref name="Part Five">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jensu first appeared in the [[Part Four: Fallen Jedi|fourth episode]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part Four" /> which aired on [[September 5]], [[2023]].<ref name="Part Four Release">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Jensu was portrayed by [[Chau Naumova]].<ref name="Part Four" />
